// diagnostic

E0121

`{name}` was consumed by `{consumer}`, so it can't be used here

What

`{name}` was consumed by `{consumer}`, so it can't be used here

Why

After a value moves to another name, the old name no longer gives access to it

Fix

Move `{name}` only to its consuming use `{consumer}`, or write `~{name}` before reusing it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0121: tests/ui/frozen_capture_use_after_move.stderr.

Error [E0121]: `frozen` was consumed by `escaping lambda`, so it can't be used here
  --> tests/ui/frozen_capture_use_after_move.jet:11:18
    |
 11 |     print(frozen.value)
    |                  ^^^^^
 Why: After a value moves to another name, the old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: Give away a copy instead (`~frozen`) where it moved
move site: source bytes 121..128; reuse site: source bytes 202..207; consuming callee: escaping lambda
